Resolves #19798

On a grid with locked columns, a sort left stale arrows on the locked headers, because the header-wide walks stopped at the center toolbar. The new `Wrapper#getToolbars()` lists every header toolbar from left to right. All header-wide walks now use it: the sort reset, the runtime `showHeaderFilters` / `sortable` / `useTriStateSorting` hooks, and three existing inline lists it replaces. A locked toolbar created after a runtime change takes the center toolbar's current values, not its construction configs.

Evidence: L2 (unit specs red on `dev`, a mutation, a live drive of the issues showcase) → L2 required (AC-1–AC-4).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Live on `examples/grid/issues` at `e957d741c7`: after Title, then State, only State has a sort class without `neo-sort-hidden`. On `dev` `af81fc0f86`, `#`, Title and State all showed arrows. |
| AC-2 | `LockedColumns.spec.mjs`, "a sort clears every other header's sort state, whichever region holds it", sorts a start, center, end and start column in turn. On `dev` it fails at the second step, with the locked-start `col3` still `'ASC'`. |
| AC-3 | `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs`, "a runtime header config change reaches every header region and its buttons, existing or created later". On `dev` it fails at the locked-start toolbar. With the clone's current values removed, it fails at the re-created end toolbar. |
| AC-4 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid test/playwright/unit/table`: 296 passed. The grid e2e folder: 246 passed. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The clone path: `Neo.cloneNeoInstance` starts from construction configs, so a locked toolbar created after a runtime change (a column locked into an empty region) reverted that change. `updateHeaders` now hands the clone the center toolbar's current header-wide values. Ticket body updated.

## Test Evidence
- Red first: both new specs fail against the unchanged sources (see AC-2, AC-3).
- Mutation: with the three clone values dropped from `Wrapper#updateHeaders`, the runtime spec fails at the end toolbar; restored, it passes.
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/grid test/playwright/unit/table`: 296 passed.
- `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid` with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`: 246 passed (7.5 min).
